# Chessly Overview (synthetic fixture)

## What Chessly is
Chessly is a fictional test product: an imaginary checkers learning
platform. It exists only to exercise the knowledge pipeline in unit
tests; it is not Zhatura and carries no Zhatura facts.

## Chessly Pricing Example
Chessly costs 7000 testcoins per epoch. This line is deliberately a
pricing CLAIM so validator and pricing-guard tests have something to
catch; it must never appear in production knowledge.
